entities.summary: Tao Ruspoli (b. 1975-11-07, Bangkok) was a visual artist or sculptor of the Contemporary era, characterized by technology, globalization, and rapid social change, active in Bangkok and United States. Known in the fields of united states, composers & musicians, americas.
